hero.title: A book you can talk to
hero.description: Create a textbook, a course, a presentation, a manual or a story — in writing or by voice, with photos and video. Any reader simply asks the book and gets an answer from its content: in their own language, simpler or in more depth, out loud.
hero.leafBack: A book is written once. Hundreds of readers will talk to it — each in their own way and language.
hero.leafFront:
— Why doesn't ice sink?
— Because ice is less dense than water: the same volume weighs less…
hero.leafCaption: A reader asked — the book answered from its own text and showed the chapter
features.title: Make books interactive
features.0.title: Write or dictate
features.0.text: Type, or simply talk — the AI helper shapes the text and suggests what to expand. Photos, video and sound go right into the chapter.
features.1.title: Ask the book
features.1.text: Any question about the content — by voice or in writing. The answer comes from the book itself and leads to the right chapter. Ask for «simpler», «for a child» or «test me».
features.2.title: In your language, out loud
features.2.text: One button — another language, plain language or a version for children. Any chapter and any answer can be listened to.
features.3.title: Private or for everyone
features.3.text: Only the people you invite see the book — or everyone, if you publish it. Someone without an account can get a time-limited link.
steps.title: How it works
steps.0: Create a book — a textbook, presentation, documentation or a story — and write or dictate the first chapter.
steps.1: Invite readers by email, send a link, or publish the book.
steps.2: Readers ask the book, listen and discuss — and you see their questions and add to the book.
footer: Books for reading, learning, and sharing knowledge.
